text: Underway in round ten as GLM FC face Synthetic Athletic.
Griezmatronn makes the shout early, alerting Robodinho that the red shirt is stepping up to contest possession.
Robodinho breaks clean through down the left channel! Not a defender in sight between the striker and the net!
Griezmatronn calls to work the wall.
And Robodinho buries it from point-blank range! First blood to Synthetic Athletic, making it one-nil!
Zhi topples over completely unaided.
The powered corner push-panel fires the ball straight back into the final third.
Robodinho taps it in right at the goal mouth! Synthetic Athletic double their lead to two-nil.
Robodinho bursts clean through the middle again, with acres of space ahead.
Just wide of the post.
Griezmatronn calls out that the ball is secured by the wall. Synthetic Athletic are a frozen club, running the exact same setup they started with on day one.
Pu bundles it over the line from point-blank range! GLM FC are right back in this contest, pulling it back to one-two!
Robodinho charges up the middle.
Robodinho scores again! A ruthless finish from two metres out to restore the two-goal cushion at three-one.
Robodinho slips through the centre once more, clean through on goal.
Pu calls out that the ball is coming free right in front of goal. GLM fielded an unchanged squad today, sticking loyally with their system.
Griezmatronn loses balance on the touchline and hits the deck. The gyros will have the red shirt back on its feet shortly.
A lull here as Pu looks to reset. GLM are still seeking their first points of the season, but they are creating chances.
Robodinho topples over without a blue shirt near them. Just a misjudged step in their own half.
Griezmatronn signals to the teammate that the ball is wedged tight against the wall in midfield.
Pu works the ball three metres along the touchline, grinding forward into the final third.
Pu forces it home at the goal mouth! Right on the stroke of half-time, GLM make it two-three!
The buzzer sounds, power cuts instantly, but the ball rolls harmlessly wide.

And the ball stops for half-time at two-three. Remember, the buzzer cuts power to every robot, but the ball remains live until it comes to rest. Any momentum carrying it over the line counts as a goal.
Robodinho opens the second half with intent, driving three metres straight down the middle into the attacking third.
Pu surges towards the net.
Pu lets fly, but it slides a metre wide of the target. A big opportunity missed for GLM.
Griezmatronn calls to clear it.
The corner push-panel triggers instantly, cannoning the ball straight back out into the defensive third.
Inches away! A fraction of a metre wide as the ball clips past the post.
Griezmatronn is heard shouting to work the ball away from the boards and relieve the pressure.
A messy tangle of blue shirts! Pu and Zhi collide, leaving Pu flat on the turf.
Robodinho knocks Pu to the turf.
And Pu returns the favour immediately, clattering Robodinho down in an assertive challenge on the touchline.
Robodinho is clean through on goal!
Griezmatronn calls that the ball is breaking off the wall.
Robodinho finishes it! Synthetic Athletic extend their lead to four-two.
Robodinho carried it right inside.
Synthetic Athletic are pinning GLM deep in their own territory, suffocating any attempt to build from the back.
Flashed just wide of goal.
Zhi stabs it in from point-blank range! GLM strike back, and it is three-four with time running out!
Disaster for GLM as Zhi collapses in midfield! Vital seconds ticking away.
Agonisingly close, brushing the outside post!
Griezmatronn hammers it home! A devastating response from Synthetic Athletic to make it three-five with under two minutes remaining!
Zhi breaks clean through the middle! Nobody ahead of the blue shirt, a golden chance to respond!
Robodinho carries the ball four metres up the pitch, eating up precious seconds deep in GLM territory.
Under forty seconds left and GLM need a miracle. They have given everything today, but time is simply slipping away.
Pu scores! It is four-five, but there are only seconds left!
Buzzer sounds, ball trickles dead.
GLM threw everything forward right until the buzzer.
Full time, 4-5. Next: Muse Spark face AFC Fable, Sunday at 20:00 UK, 21:00 Europe, 15:00 US East.
